name: Mark Practice Answer
description: Deterministic binary math marker for Practice. Loads the question by id, reads metadata.marking rules, and returns only { isCorrect, verdict, questionId }.

FETCH_Q.name: Load question row
FETCH_Q.__wwdescription: Fetch model answer and marking metadata for the submitted question.

MARK_ANSWER.name: Run deterministic marker
MARK_ANSWER.__wwdescription: Compare student answer to model answer using emath-marker compact engine.

RETURN_MARK.name: Return mark verdict
RETURN_MARK.__wwdescription: Return binary Correct/Wrong verdict to the frontend.
